title: Unexpected Outcomes: と思いきや, が最後, ばそれまでだ, (よ)うものなら, ためしがない, ずじまい, ものを
description: I thought …, but; once you …, it's over; if you dared to; never once; ended up never; and if only.

points.title: 〜と思いきや: I thought …, but
points.summary: Plain form + と思いきや = I expected A, but surprisingly not.
points.body: - 晴れる**と思いきや**、急に雨が降り出した.
examples: {簡単|かんたん}だと{思|おも}いきや、{意外|いがい}に{難|むずか}しかった。
I thought it'd be easy, but it was surprisingly hard.

points.title: 〜が最後 / たら最後: once (… no going back)
points.summary: た-form + が最後 = once A happens, B (bad, unstoppable) follows.
points.body: - 彼は話し始めた**が最後**、二時間は止まらない.
examples: この{森|もり}に{入|はい}ったが{最後|さいご}、{二度|にど}と{出|で}られない。
Once you enter this forest, you can never get out.

points.title: 〜ばそれまでだ: if …, that's the end
points.summary: ば-form + それまでだ = if A happens, everything is over / pointless.
points.body: - いくらお金があっても、死んでしまえ**ばそれまでだ**.
examples: {一度|いちど}{信用|しんよう}を{失|うしな}えばそれまでだ。
Once you lose people's trust, it's all over.

points.title: (よ)うものなら: if you dared to (… disaster)
points.summary: Volitional + ものなら = if you were to do A, something terrible would happen.
points.body: - 父に反対しよう**ものなら**、家を追い出されるだろう.
examples: {一分|いっぷん}でも{遅刻|ちこく}しようものなら、{先生|せんせい}に{叱|しか}られる。
If you're even a minute late, the teacher will tell you off.

points.title: 〜ためしがない: never once
points.summary: た-form + ためしがない = there's never been a single case of A (complaint).
points.body: - 彼が約束を守った**ためしがない**.
examples: {兄|あに}は{時間|じかん}{通|どお}りに{来|き}たためしがない。
My brother has never once arrived on time.

points.title: 〜ずじまい: ended up never
points.summary: ない-stem + ずじまい = in the end, A never happened (regret).
points.body: - 忙しくて、あの映画は見**ずじまい**だった.
examples: {名前|なまえ}を{聞|き}かずじまいだった。
I never did ask their name.

points.title: 〜ものを: if only (regret / reproach)
points.summary: Plain form + ものを = it would have been fine if …, but (you didn't).
points.body: - 早く言ってくれれば手伝った**ものを**.
examples: {薬|くすり}を{飲|の}めば{治|なお}るものを、{彼|かれ}は{飲|の}もうとしない。
If he'd just take the medicine he'd get better — yet he won't.

questions.prompt: {晴|は}れると（　）、{急|きゅう}に{雨|あめ}が{降|ふ}り{出|だ}した。
questions.translation: I thought it would clear up, but suddenly it started to rain.

questions.prompt: What does 「{簡単|かんたん}だと{思|おも}いきや、{意外|いがい}に{難|むずか}しかった。」 mean?
options: I thought it was hard, and it was.
I thought it'd be easy, but it was surprisingly hard.

questions.prompt: {彼|かれ}は{話|はな}し{始|はじ}めた（　）、{二時間|にじかん}は{止|と}まらない。
notes: が早いか is for a single past event, not a habit like this.
questions.translation: Once he starts talking, he won't stop for two hours.

questions.prompt: What does 「この{森|もり}に{入|はい}ったが{最後|さいご}、{二度|にど}と{出|で}られない。」 mean?
options: The last person to enter the forest never came out.
Once you enter this forest, you can never get out.
This is the last time you can enter the forest.
notes: 最後 here isn't 'the last person'.

questions.prompt: いくらお{金|かね}があっても、{死|し}んでしまえ（　）。
questions.explanation: If …, that's the end: **ばそれまでだ**.
questions.translation: No matter how rich you are, once you're dead, that's it.

questions.prompt: What does 「{一度|いちど}{信用|しんよう}を{失|うしな}えばそれまでだ。」 mean?
options: Once you lose people's trust, it's all over.
questions.explanation: ばそれまでだ = **then it's over**.
notes: それまで = the end of it.

questions.prompt: {父|ちち}に{反対|はんたい}しよう（　）、{家|いえ}を{追|お}い{出|だ}されるだろう。
questions.explanation: If you dared to: **(よ)うものなら**.
questions.translation: If I were to stand up to my father, he'd throw me out.

questions.prompt: What does 「{一分|いっぷん}でも{遅刻|ちこく}しようものなら、{先生|せんせい}に{叱|しか}られる。」 mean?
options: The teacher is a minute late.
Try to be a minute late.
Because I was a minute late, I got told off.
If you're even a minute late, the teacher will tell you off.
questions.explanation: うものなら = **if you dared to**.
notes: It's a condition, not a past event.

questions.prompt: {彼|かれ}が{約束|やくそく}を{守|まも}った（　）。
notes: ためにならない = 'does no good'.
questions.translation: He has never once kept a promise.

questions.prompt: What does 「{兄|あに}は{時間|じかん}{通|どお}りに{来|き}たためしがない。」 mean?
options: My brother tried coming on time.
My brother has never once arrived on time.
My brother always comes on time.
My brother came on time as a test.

questions.prompt: {忙|いそが}しくて、{結局|けっきょく}あの{映画|えいが}は{見|み}ず（　）だった。
notes: 見ずには needs a verb after it.
questions.translation: I was so busy that I never ended up seeing that film.

questions.prompt: What does 「{名前|なまえ}を{聞|き}かずじまいだった。」 mean?
options: I asked without saying my name.
I asked their name at the end.
I didn't hear the name clearly.
I never did ask their name.

questions.prompt: {早|はや}く{言|い}ってくれれば{手伝|てつだ}った（　）。
questions.translation: If only you'd told me sooner, I'd have helped.

questions.prompt: What does 「{薬|くすり}を{飲|の}めば{治|なお}るものを、{彼|かれ}は{飲|の}もうとしない。」 mean?
options: If he'd just take the medicine he'd get better — yet he won't.
The medicine doesn't work, so he won't take it.
He drinks instead of taking medicine.
He takes medicine, so he's better.
questions.explanation: ものを = **it would have been fine, but**.
